profile.subtitleJa: レハブアムの妻マアカの祖父として名が記されています。
profile.summaryJa: 歴代誌下11:20–21は、マアカをアブサロムの孫娘として記します。

facts.textJa: レハブアムがマアカを特に愛したと記されます。

wikipedia.title: Absalom
wikipedia.noteJa: 英語版記事は、マアカをアブサロムの娘または孫娘として挙げています。歴代誌下11:20もマアカをアブサロムの孫娘と記します。

primaryWitnesses.text: After her, he took Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.

primaryWitnesses.text: Rehoboam loved Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines; for he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and became the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

wikipediaCheck.basisJa: The article’s entry says Maacah was Absalom’s daughter or granddaughter, while the fixed WEB at 2 Chronicles 11:20 specifically calls her his granddaughter; this supports a relation but is not used to equate every Absalom mention.
wikipediaCheck.locator: L195: article calls Maacah a daughter or granddaughter of Absalom and says she later became Rehoboam’s wife; comparison limited to the relation stated at 2 Chronicles 11:20.
